aboutHeadline: Commercial understanding, creative craft and practical delivery in one place.
aboutBody: I connect brand, design, digital marketing and web development to help businesses turn ideas into practical tools, campaigns and customer experiences. My experience spans graphic design, print production, websites, e-commerce, multimedia, CRM and sales. I work with Adobe tools, WordPress, Shopify and practical AI workflows. My Christian faith shapes my commitment to servant leadership, integrity and stewardship, and I take responsibility for seeing work through.
